nonResidentOwnership.summary: No nationality restriction on buying rural land; a tax number is needed.

residency.summary: Land purchase does not grant residency; separate visa routes exist and permit ownership.

zoning.summary: Building on rural land runs through the municipal chamber; protected zones can rule out residential construction on land that can still be bought.

firstClaim: No statutory pre-emption holder identified for rural land in the sources opened.

steps.what: Check the parcel against the protected-zone maps before any offer.
Ask the chamber in writing whether a dwelling is permissible on the parcel.

ruledOut: Buying land does not by itself carry water rights or a right to build.
directionNote: Residency-by-investment route for real estate removed in October 2023.
gaps: Whether scheme water allocations transfer with the parcel was not covered by a primary source.
